Subject: Overcharge on Aug usage — request for credit and VAT proof

Hi Soojin,

We just finished our internal review of August usage and noticed a 27% overage on token billing compared to our expected baseline. The charge appears on invoice INV-2025-0812. Can Redwood confirm whether this was a pricing/ingestion error or if any unusual runs were attributed to our account?

If this is on Redwood, we need a service credit and a VAT-compliant credit note that our accounting team can apply to the month of Sept. Also, please indicate if you can amortize the credit across the next three invoices — our CFO prefers a staggered adjustment.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we have our month-end close next Monday.

Thanks,
Tom

Billing Manager, ClearHarbor Inc.

Hi Tom — thanks for flagging this and for the invoice attachment. I pulled the billing logs and see an atypical downstream job that inflated token counts on 2025-08-12 (trace id: rwd-trace-4b9). We own this; it looks like a routing duplication that affected a small subset of customers.

Proposed remediation:
- Goodwill/service credit: $9,720 gross (matches 27% delta)
- Allocation: we can issue a single credit note, or per your CFO's preference, amortize the credit over three monthly invoices (Sep/Oct/Nov) in equal installments ($3,240 each).
- VAT handling: we will produce a VAT-compliant credit note (reverse-charge/credit memo depending on your country). Please confirm the company VAT number you want on the note.

I attached a draft amortization schedule and a redwood internal incident log excerpt for context. If you confirm the amortization and provide the VAT ID we will: 1) create the credit note and 2) update the invoice register so your accounting team can apply it immediately.

Next steps (can do today):
1) Confirm amortization preference (one-time vs three installments)
2) Share VAT number for the credit note
3) I'll loop in billing operations to generate the documents and trigger accounting.

Sorry again for the disruption — we'll get this fixed and make sure the routing rule is patched so it doesn't recur.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Soojin — ask Tom for the legal entity name and VAT/Tax ID; for US companies we'll populate the credit note with EIN as requested.

I'll create the three negative-line invoices and attach the credit schedule. Expect docs by EOD.

Marcus Lin
